mapper.sql: left join kb_billing_rule_versions bv on bv.id = ( select v.id from kb_billing_rule_versions v where v.rule_id = br.id order by (v.status = 'ACTIVE') desc, v.effective_from desc, v.id desc limit 1 )

br.id, br.code, br.provider_code, p.name as provider_name, br.logical_model_code, lm.model_name as logical_model_name, br.status, br.remark, bv.version_code, bv.uniq_hash, bv.billing_mode, bv.currency, bv.unit, bv.config_json, bv.effective_from, bv.effective_to
mapper.select:
select from kb_billing_rules br left join kb_providers p on br.provider_code = p.code left join kb_logical_models lm on br.logical_model_code = lm.model_code
br.status != 'DELETED'
and ( br.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or lm.model_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or lm.model_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and (br.provider_code = #{providerCode} or br.provider_code is null)
and (br.logical_model_code = #{logicalModelCode} or br.logical_model_code is null)
order by br.id desc

select from kb_billing_rules br left join kb_providers p on br.provider_code = p.code left join kb_logical_models lm on br.logical_model_code = lm.model_code
where br.id = #{id} and br.status != 'DELETED'

select from kb_billing_rules br inner join kb_billing_rule_versions bv on br.id = bv.rule_id left join kb_providers p on br.provider_code = p.code left join kb_logical_models lm on br.logical_model_code = lm.model_code where br.id = #{ruleId} and br.status = 'ACTIVE' and bv.status = 'ACTIVE' and bv.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} and (bv.effective_to is null or bv.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) order by bv.effective_from desc, bv.id desc limit 1

select from kb_billing_rules br inner join kb_billing_rule_versions bv on br.id = bv.rule_id left join kb_providers p on br.provider_code = p.code left join kb_logical_models lm on br.logical_model_code = lm.model_code where br.status = 'ACTIVE' and bv.status = 'ACTIVE' and bv.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} and (bv.effective_to is null or bv.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) and ( (br.provider_code = #{providerCode} and br.logical_model_code = ( select pm.logical_model_code from kb_provider_model_mappings pm where pm.model_id = #{modelId} limit 1 )) or (br.provider_code = #{providerCode} and br.logical_model_code is null) or (br.provider_code is null and br.logical_model_code is null) ) order by case when br.provider_code = #{providerCode} and br.logical_model_code is not null then 1 when br.provider_code = #{providerCode} and br.logical_model_code is null then 2 else 3 end, bv.effective_from desc, br.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_billing_rules(code, provider_code, logical_model_code, status, remark) values(#{code}, #{providerCode}, #{logicalModelCode}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select id, rule_id, version_code, uniq_hash, billing_mode, currency, unit, config_json, status, effective_from, effective_to from kb_billing_rule_versions where rule_id = #{ruleId} order by effective_from desc, id desc limit 1

select id, rule_id, version_code, uniq_hash, billing_mode, currency, unit, config_json, status, effective_from, effective_to from kb_billing_rule_versions where rule_id = #{ruleId} and uniq_hash = #{uniqHash} limit 1
select count(1) from kb_billing_rule_versions where rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_billing_rule_versions(rule_id, version_code, uniq_hash, billing_mode, currency, unit, config_json, status, effective_from, effective_to) values(#{ruleId}, #{versionCode}, #{uniqHash}, #{billingMode}, #{currency}, #{unit}, #{configJson}, #{status}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo})
mapper.update: update kb_billing_rule_versions set status = 'DISABLED' where rule_id = #{ruleId} and id != #{keepId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
